ANSWER: NO
HALLUCINATIONS: None

The memo accurately reflects all key financial terms present in the source document:

- Deal Size: $1,000,000,000 (correctly stated in source as "Aggregate Commitment is $1,000,000,000")
- Maturity Date: November 22, 2028 (correctly referenced in source amendment)
- Original agreement date: November 22, 2022 (accurate)
- Amendment date: May 12, 2025 (accurate)
- Administrative Agent: JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. (accurate)
- Lender names and commitment amounts from Schedule 2.01 (accurate)
- Covenant modification: "no more than one (1) time" (accurate)
- Governing Law: New York State Law (accurate)

Where the memo states "N/A" for terms like interest rates, payment frequency, etc., this correctly reflects that these terms are not specified in the amendment document. The memo appropriately notes limitations in available information and does not fabricate financial terms not present in the source.

ANSWER: YES
MISSING_TERMS: 
• Individual lender commitment amounts (JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A.: $250,000,000; Citibank, N.A.: $210,000,000; Bank of America, N.A.: $190,000,000; Morgan Stanley Bank, N.A.: $190,000,000; HSBC Bank USA, National Association: $80,000,000; The Toronto-Dominion Bank, New York Branch: $80,000,000)
• Section 2.20 amendment changing "$500,000,000" to "$0" (material covenant or limit modification)
• Original credit agreement date (November 22, 2022) and Amendment No. 1 date (April 17, 2025) for context
• Upfront fees payable to lenders upon execution
• Amendment No. 2 Effective Date definition (May 12, 2025)
